character: A lean woman, slate-grey feathers shading pale at the throat, one white streak down a wing. Sharp amber eyes, beak set, alert.
wardrobe: Worn flight leathers, a fleece-lined coat, pilot's goggles pushed up into her crest feathers, a whistle on a cord.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing on a ship's rail in the wind, perfectly balanced.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Leaping from a small flying skiff onto a ship's rail beneath floating islands of dark rock hung with airships.
